# Test pe optimize command - prompt optimization

# Basic optimization with PE2
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method pe2
stdout 'Optimizing prompt with 3 iterations using pe2 method'
stdout 'Optimization Results'
stdout 'Improvement Score:'
exists prompt_optimized.txt

# TextGrad optimization
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method textgrad --iterations 5
stdout 'TextGrad optimization'
stdout 'Computing semantic gradients'
stdout 'Iteration'
stdout 'Applied gradient'
exists prompt_textgrad.txt

# Semantic backpropagation (2025)
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method semantic-backprop --objective "accuracy"
stdout 'Semantic backpropagation'
stdout 'Computing directional semantic information'
stdout 'Confidence score:'
stdout 'Optimization complete'

# GASO optimization for systems
exec pe optimize system.json --method gaso --multi-objective
stdout 'GASO optimization'
stdout 'Building computational graph'
stdout 'Optimizing component:'
stdout 'Pareto frontier'
exists system_optimized.json

# Evolution-based optimization
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method evolve --generations 10 --population 20
stdout 'Evolutionary optimization'
stdout 'Generation 1/10'
stdout 'Best fitness:'
stdout 'Mutation:'
stdout 'Crossover:'

# Multi-stage optimization
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method multistage
stdout 'Stage 1: Analysis'
stdout 'Stage 2: Enhancement'
stdout 'Stage 3: Validation'
stdout 'Quality gate: PASSED'

# Hybrid optimization
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method hybrid --combine pe2,textgrad,evolve
stdout 'Hybrid optimization'
stdout 'Method 1: PE2'
stdout 'Method 2: TextGrad'
stdout 'Method 3: Evolution'
stdout 'Consensus strategy'

# Optimization with constraints
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --max-tokens 100 --preserve-style
stdout 'Constrained optimization'
stdout 'Token limit: 100'
stdout 'Style preserved'

# Compare optimization methods
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --compare-methods pe2,textgrad,semantic
stdout 'Method comparison'
stdout 'PE2: Score'
stdout 'TextGrad: Score'
stdout 'Semantic: Score'
stdout 'Winner:'

# Optimization with custom objective
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --objective "clarity and conciseness" --method textgrad
stdout 'Objective: clarity and conciseness'
stdout 'Optimizing for objective'

# Failed optimization (no convergence)
exec pe optimize bad-prompt.txt --method textgrad --max-iterations 3
stdout 'No convergence after 3 iterations'
stdout 'Best attempt saved'

-- prompt.txt --
Analyze the sentiment of the given text.

-- system.json --
{
  "components": {
    "analyzer": {
      "prompt": "Extract key information",
      "dependencies": []
    },
    "summarizer": {
      "prompt": "Summarize the analysis",
      "dependencies": ["analyzer"]
    }
  },
  "objective": "accuracy and latency"
}

-- bad-prompt.txt --
Do thing
